  [apply]     simp_all only [ne_eq, Multiplicative.forall, ofAdd_eq_one, EmbeddingLike.apply_eq_iff_eq, one_ne_zero,

Try this:

  [apply]     simp_all only [ne_eq, Multiplicative.forall, ofAdd_eq_one, EmbeddingLike.apply_eq_iff_eq, one_ne_zero,
      not_false_eq_true, ite_eq_left_iff, imp_false, Decidable.not_not]
    split
    next h =>
      subst h
      simp_all only
    next h => duper [*] {preprocessing := full}
